## `mainframe.cpu`

**Status:** ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue)

A physical mainframe processor within the Central Processing Complex (CPC) — the mainframe equivalent of a CPU core in a distributed server.

**Type:** `mainframe.cpu`

**Requirement Level:** `Recommended`

**Attributes:**

| Role | Key | Stability | [Requirement Level](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/general/attribute-requirement-level/) | Value Type | Description | Example Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Identity | [`mainframe.cpu.name`](/docs/registry/mainframe/README.md#mainframe-cpu-name) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Recommended` | string | The name of the mainframe processor, formed as the processor type abbreviation followed by the processor index number. [1] | `IFL01`; `CP02`; `zIIP03` |
| Identity | [`virtualization.platform.id`](/docs/registry/virtualization/README.md#virtualization-platform-id) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Recommended` | string | Unique identifier for the virtualization platform. [2] | `3931-45A01`; `4c4c4544-0042-3510-8058-b4c04f4e3732` |
| Description | [`mainframe.cpu.type`](/docs/registry/mainframe/README.md#mainframe-cpu-type) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Required` | string | The type of mainframe processor within the Central Processing Complex (CPC). | `all`; `cp`; `icf` |

**[1] `mainframe.cpu.name`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API processor object. In distributed systems terms, a mainframe processor is analogous to a physical CPU core.

**[2] `virtualization.platform.id`:** The Central Processing Complex (CPC) the processor belongs to; processor names such as `CP02` repeat on every CPC.

---

`mainframe.cpu.type` has the following list of well-known values. If one of them applies, then the respective value MUST be used; otherwise, a custom value MAY be used.

| Value | Description | Stability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `aap` | Application Assist Processor (AAP), a processor dedicated to accelerating Java and XML processing for database workloads. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `all` | All types of mainframe processors combined. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `cbp` | Container Based Processor (CBP), a processor type for container-based workloads. Present only in HMC/SE versions 2.14.0 through 2.15.0. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `cp` | Central Processor (CP), the general-purpose processor that hosts a mainframe operating system such as z/OS. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `icf` | Integrated Coupling Facility (ICF), a processor dedicated to running coupling facility workloads for high-speed communication between systems in a sysplex. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `ifl` | Integrated Facility for Linux (IFL), a processor dedicated to running Linux workloads on the mainframe. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `iip` | z Integrated Information Processor (zIIP), a processor dedicated to offloading eligible workloads such as Java applications from general-purpose processors. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `sap` | System Assist Processor (SAP), a processor dedicated to system management and I/O processing workloads. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |

## `mainframe.storage.group`

**Status:** ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue)

A DPM storage group — a named collection of block storage volumes of a single connectivity type (FCP, FC, or NVMe) that can be attached to one or more DPM partitions. Analogous to a Kubernetes StorageClass or a cloud storage pool.

**Type:** `mainframe.storage.group`

**Requirement Level:** `Recommended`

**Attributes:**

| Role | Key | Stability | [Requirement Level](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/general/attribute-requirement-level/) | Value Type | Description | Example Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Identity | [`mainframe.storage.group.name`](/docs/registry/mainframe/README.md#mainframe-storage-group-name) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Recommended` | string | The name of the DPM storage group attached to the Central Processing Complex (CPC). [3] | `sg-fcp-prod`; `sg-nvme-test` |
| Identity | [`virtualization.platform.id`](/docs/registry/virtualization/README.md#virtualization-platform-id) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Recommended` | string | Unique identifier for the virtualization platform. [4] | `3931-45A01`; `4c4c4544-0042-3510-8058-b4c04f4e3732` |
| Description | [`mainframe.storage.group.type`](/docs/registry/mainframe/README.md#mainframe-storage-group-type) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Required` | string | The connectivity type of the DPM storage group. [5] | `fcp`; `fc`; `nvme` |
| Description | [`host.name`](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions/blob/v1.44.0/docs/registry/attributes/host.md) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Recommended` | string | Name of the host. On UNIX systems, it may contain what the hostname command returns, or the fully qualified hostname, or another name specified by the user. [6] | `opentelemetry-test` |

**[3] `mainframe.storage.group.name`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API storage-group resource object field `name` (DPM mode only, HMC ≥ 2.14.1). A storage group aggregates storage volumes of the same connectivity type (FCP, FC, NVMe) that are managed together and can be attached to partitions.

**[4] `virtualization.platform.id`:** The Central Processing Complex (CPC) the storage group belongs to.

**[5] `mainframe.storage.group.type`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API storage-group object field `type` (DPM mode only, HMC ≥ 2.14.1).

**[6] `host.name`:** The name of the Central Processing Complex (CPC) that owns this storage group.

---

`mainframe.storage.group.type` has the following list of well-known values. If one of them applies, then the respective value MUST be used; otherwise, a custom value MAY be used.

| Value | Description | Stability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fc` | FC (native Fibre Channel / ECKD) storage group — IBM ECKD disk format. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `fcp` | FCP (Fibre Channel Protocol) storage group — SCSI over Fibre Channel. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
| `nvme` | NVMe storage group — NVMe over Fabrics. | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |

**Status:** ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue)

A DPM storage volume — a single unit of block storage (LUN, ECKD DASD cylinder set, or NVMe namespace) within a storage group. Analogous to a Kubernetes Persistent Volume or a cloud block storage volume.

**Type:** `mainframe.storage.group.volume`

**Requirement Level:** `Recommended`

**Attributes:**

| Role | Key | Stability | [Requirement Level](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/general/attribute-requirement-level/) | Value Type | Description | Example Values |

| Identity | [`mainframe.storage.group.name`](/docs/registry/mainframe/README.md#mainframe-storage-group-name) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Recommended` | string | The name of the DPM storage group attached to the Central Processing Complex (CPC). [7] | `sg-fcp-prod`; `sg-nvme-test` |
| Identity | [`mainframe.storage.group.volume.name`](/docs/registry/mainframe/README.md#mainframe-storage-group-volume-name) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Recommended` | string | The name of the DPM storage volume within a storage group. [8] | `vol-boot-0`; `vol-data-1` |
| Identity | [`virtualization.platform.id`](/docs/registry/virtualization/README.md#virtualization-platform-id) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Recommended` | string | Unique identifier for the virtualization platform. [9] | `3931-45A01`; `4c4c4544-0042-3510-8058-b4c04f4e3732` |
| Description | [`host.name`](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions/blob/v1.44.0/docs/registry/attributes/host.md) | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | `Recommended` | string | Name of the host. On UNIX systems, it may contain what the hostname command returns, or the fully qualified hostname, or another name specified by the user. [10] | `opentelemetry-test` |

**[7] `mainframe.storage.group.name`:** The name of the storage group that contains this volume.

**[8] `mainframe.storage.group.volume.name`:** Reported by the HMC Web Services API storage-volume resource object field `name` (DPM mode only, HMC ≥ 2.14.1). A storage volume is a single logical unit of block storage (LUN / ECKD DASD cylinder set / NVMe namespace) within a storage group.

**[9] `virtualization.platform.id`:** The Central Processing Complex (CPC) the storage group belongs to.

**[10] `host.name`:** The name of the Central Processing Complex (CPC) that owns the storage group containing this volume.
